trigger: Workflow run 36316682817 failed before endpoint output because at least one state had only one route cluster, making cluster-robust covariance undefined.

state_specific_slopes.primary_fit: Use the frozen state-specific model and route-cluster covariance when >=2 route clusters and residual degrees of freedom are positive.
state_specific_slopes.nonestimable_rule: If cluster-robust covariance is undefined or the fitted model has non-positive residual degrees of freedom, mark inferential state-specific slope as nonestimable rather than changing the model.
state_specific_slopes.descriptive_fallback: For direction-only display, fit response ~ rain_contrast when >=3 observations and rain_contrast varies; label this explicitly descriptive_unadjusted and do not use its CI/P value.
state_specific_slopes.pass_role: None. State-specific estimates remain descriptive and never determine PASS/FAIL.

repair.leave_one_state_out: Unchanged from V0_1 and remains the primary PASS/strong-PASS criterion.
